sentences.text: A Tier 3 UCB may levy a pre-payment charge on a floating-rate business loan to an MSE sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026 only within the stated conditions.
For a Tier 3 UCB, the no-charge rule for business-purpose loans to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises applies only to loans with sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh.

Because the loan amount is ₹80 lakh, the cited no-charge threshold is not met, so the Directions leave any pre-payment charge to the UCB's approved policy in cases outside paragraphs 261(1) and 261(2).
Any pre-payment charge must be disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and undisclosed pre-payment charges cannot be charged by a UCB.
